answer: Keep your car insured until the sale is complete and the car is in our hands, and cancel the policy or remove the car from it only after you sign the paperwork; ask your insurer about a refund for any unused premium. If your plates were issued by North Carolina, leave them on the car, because what happens to plates depends on the issuing state rather than where you live, and North Carolina plates stay with the vehicle. Before handing over the car, remove toll tags and parking stickers, clear garage door codes, unpair your phone, and remove the car from any connected-car app account.
